payload.description:
## Trigger

When a customer or an agent starts the board and the port is taken, I want a named refusal that gives a free-port command, so I can start the board without reading a Python traceback.

## Context

Found by the basicly-9pyaygb.5 walk: basicly-board serve on a taken 8765 raised OSError Errno 98 Address already in use from .basicly/core/kit/board/server.py. Every agent run needed --port.
payload.requirements: The refusal names the command to run instead.
payload.title: board serve on a busy port raises a traceback
